decisions.decision: Students self-register; librarians use same flow, promoted by admin superuser
decisions.rationale: Simpler than separate flows; no chicken-and-egg problem

decisions.decision: JWT in localStorage, 24h TTL, no refresh token in v1
decisions.rationale: School intranet SPA; complexity not warranted
Cannot be retrofitted after loan data exists

decisions.decision: RBAC via FastAPI DI at router level
decisions.rationale: Per-route checks cause auth gaps over time

decisions.decision: Docker: base + override.yml for dev, hot reload for both FastAPI and React
decisions.rationale: Standard Docker Compose pattern, faster dev iteration
